text:
alex: Deploybot flagged preflight-eval: summarizer prompt-suite regression -3.8% ROUGE-L. Holding release. @maya can you triage?

maya: On it — grabbing the eval diff and samples now. Pushing raw diffs to the thread.

maya: ```json
{"suite":"summarizer_prompt_suite","metric":"rouge_l","baseline":"v10.2","candidate":"v10.3","delta":"-3.8"}
```

qa-bot: Regression concentrated on long-tail list prompts and bullet compression. Top-k token distribution shifted slightly due to quant path. P95 latency unchanged.

samir: Quick options: 1) Pin release to v10.2 for the change window and backport a hotfix to v10.3 later. 2) Staggered rollforward (30% traffic to v10.3) + monitor, rollback if metric cross threshold. 3) Full rollback to v10.1 if we suspect a model artifact.

julia: For customer-facing summarizer I'd prefer pin+hotfix. Staggered rollforward means some users will see worse outputs during the window.

alex: Ops question — how long to pin vs rollback? @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: Rollback to v10.1: ~20 min for routing + validation, plus extra 30 min QA signoff. Pin to v10.2 (explicit routing override) is ~30-45 min end-to-end (change, config deploy, smoke). Staggered rollforward is fastest to start but carries risk.

maya: Quick triage notes: tokenizer normalization tweak in v10.3 quantization pipeline changed output tokenization for list items. I can try a behavioral mitigation (post-token-normalize filter) and run canary on subset. If mitigation reduces delta to <1.0% we can proceed.

samir: If mitigation looks promising, we can do a short canary + pin as backup. If not, pin immediately. Also note: docs and release notes need to call out the pinned model version for customers in the change window.

alex: Agreed. Plan: hold full rollout. Start pin to v10.2 for the release window now. Initiate a canary with maya's patch on 10% traffic simultaneously. If canary shows delta <1% within 30m, consider staged rollforward; otherwise keep pin and schedule hotfix release.

maya: Starting canary now. Command I ran: ```bash
redwoodctl deploy canary --model v10.3-mitigation --traffic 10 --id c-227400
```

deploybot: Canary started (id: c-227400). Monitoring metrics: rouge_l_delta=-0.9% @10m, error_rate=0.12%, latency_p95 unchanged. Sending alerts to #eng-monitoring.

julia: -0.9% is much better. Still below our guardrail of -1.0? We need to confirm over the 30m window and sample qualitative outputs.

maya: Pushing sample pairs (baseline vs candidate) in thread: some improvements on concision, but lists still occasionally compress numbers. Working on a narrow tokenizer post-process.

alex: Ops, proceed with pin now. @sre-oncall initiate routing override to v10.2 and attach release note blurb: "Pinned model to v10.2 during change window after preflight eval detected regression in v10.3; investigating and planning hotfix."

sre-oncall: Pinning in progress. Command: ```bash
redwoodctl route set --model v10.2 --scope release-window-2026-03-20 --force true
```

maya: :thumbsup: continuing patch work. If I get a stable mitigation in the next 3 hours we can schedule a hotfix release and revert the pin in the next maintenance window.

deploybot: Release window pinned to v10.2. Canary c-227400 will continue running but full roll aborted for now. Notifying stakeholders and closing immediate release path.

alex: Thanks all — keep updates here. If canary regresses again, escalate and we'll rollback older model.

qa-bot: Note for release notes: include pinned model version, reason (preflight eval regression), and expected follow-up (hotfix / revert timeline).

maya: Adding a short ticket for backport/hotfix and linking eval artifacts. Ticket: RDF-4821.

deploybot: Thread marked resolved for release decision.
